title: Trainer
description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
In this role, you will manage the implementation and ongoing development of all aspects of processing training including safety, workplace inductions, personal development and training for personnel within the Process Plant.
To ensure that all activities meet the K92 Mining business needs and consistently high standards of occupational health, safety and environment are met, you will ensure the continuous improvement of safety best practice in line with K92 Mining Safety System and Environmental Policies and Procedures
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Manage scheduling of training for all Process plant personnel.
Co-ordinate or conduct Process Plant inductions and / or safety training
Maintain up to date training matrix for all Processing employees
Oversee graduate development programs within the Processing department
Monitor training provided for Processing personnel and develop effective training materials, evaluations and record keeping systems consistent with existing site document control.
Ensure accurate training records are maintained.
Accurately identify training requirements for all Processing personnel through effective Training Needs Analysis, Performance Management data and through liaison with key personnel and attending appropriate meetings.
Further the development of competency assessments for all Processing personnel.
Undertake the design and continuous development of training modules, materials, and procedures.
Liaise closely with the Coordinator Training and Development (Master Trainer) and other training personnel to maximise consistency and maintain a uniform approach to training across site.
Actively promote a safe and healthy culture.
Demonstrate personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear expectations of relevant legal obligations, safe workplace practices and HSE operating practices to others, holding them accountable for their actions.
Perform general housekeeping within and around responsible work area
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you
Possess an appropriate Trade Certification with a Diploma in Tech Teaching or a Certificate IV in Workplace Training
Have a minimum of 5 years’ experience in technical training role in a mineral processing plant.
Prior experience in a supervisory role.
Well-developed computer skills with competence in MS Office Suite and Pronto.
Well-developed interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills in English
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
